environment.drawing_method: circle_shapes (font files read-only in both runs)

method: One baseline run from a clean git archive, then one final working-tree run, using the same benchmark script and display. Nine pages: initial PDF, eight cold opens, 45 cached switches, nine settled switches, eight queued clicks. No SolidWorks or native Windows compositor measurement.

before.note: Real Tk on Linux/Xvfb, no SolidWorks. Paint timings include update_idletasks; Cached paint timings exclude delayed callbacks; settled_cached timings include layout callbacks and navigation animation completion. All nine app pages covered; not a measurement of native Windows compositor frames.

after.note: Real Tk on Linux/Xvfb, no SolidWorks. Paint timings include update_idletasks; Cached paint timings exclude delayed callbacks; settled_cached timings include layout callbacks and navigation animation completion. All nine app pages covered; not a measurement of native Windows compositor frames.

limitations: One run per version; no variance estimate or broad speedup claim.
Settled times include delayed layout and navigation animation completion; removal of the 140 ms animation affects this metric.

Full update() also processes other ready events. A separate diagnostic run found its first settled PDF switch took 820 ms, with 815 ms inside update() and about 4 ms in _switch_mode. Profiling attributed most time to native Tcl/Tk calls, without identifying their internal cause. Those diagnostic values are not the paired measurements above.
Settled maximum and hidden preload median increased in the paired measurement.
